supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension visible beyond the lateral margins of the orbits

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast; muzzle and circumoral region exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) relative to dark circumocular and cheek zones

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: structural notch and loss of continuity in the superior-lateral helix of the ear on the viewer's right

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: visible notch or structural irregularity on the superior margin of the ear pinna (viewer's right)
